integrity_notes: The analytic proof establishes the infinite-size result; exact finite-state calculations and Monte Carlo are supporting checks only. Historical originality remains subject to independent verification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive switch parameters, stationary independent ON/OFF edge chains, one hub contact per unit-rate Poisson event, fixed star geometry. No nonstationary, joint parameter-size, broadcast, or general-network extension is proved.
title: A spectral Gumbel law for uniform-active collection on slowly switching stars
